description.value: As a black mage gains experience, he learns a number of talents that assist him in manipulating spells and other forms of magic. At 2nd level and every two levels thereafter, a black mage gains one mage talent. A black mage cannot select an individual talent more than once. Talents marked with an asterisk add effects to a black mage's spellcasting ability. Only one of these talents can be applied to an individual spell and the decision must be made before the spell is cast.
